use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant: quantity takeoff from drawings, unit pricing from the vendor's market data and the company's past estimates, subcontractor quote comparison, and bid narrative drafting
vendor_or_model: AI estimating SaaS vendor (computer-vision takeoff plus a generative language model); monthly subscription on click-through terms
data_categories: Drawings and specifications (FCI for FC-1 change orders; private owners' confidential drawings); company pricing and past estimates; subcontractor quotes and contact details
consequential_decision_category: None directly (business decisions about bids and subcontractors); escalates to Employment if used for hiring or crew assignment, or to Safety/CI if used for structural or life-safety quantities
human_in_the_loop: Project Manager verifies every takeoff for the 5 largest cost items and takes off MEP, demolition, and existing conditions manually; Project Manager records the reason for each subcontractor selection; the Owner approves and signs every bid
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) and DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) when FCI is uploaded; FAR 52.203-2 independent price determination on federal bids; owner contract confidentiality clauses; Sherman Act Sec. 1 (counsel); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: Approved with conditions (trial, 1 user); FCI uploads stopped until enterprise terms are signed
